Juneau, Alaska tide predictions for the week ahead.

The highest astronomical tide in this seven-day window is predicted at 16.83 ft above local MLLW at 2:40 AM on July 31, 2026. The lowest is -1.63 ft, a predicted range of 18.46 ft at NOAA station 9452210.

Times are station-local. Predictions are not observations or a flood forecast.
